verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תֹּורָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.ar: قَصِيدَةٌ لِآسَافَ اِصْغَ يَا شَعْبِي إِلَى شَرِيعَتِي. أَمِيلُوا آذَانَكُمْ إِلَى كَلَامِ فَمِي.
verses.en: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, [to] my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.web: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.he: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝ידֹ֗ות מִנִּי־קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.ar: أَفْتَحُ بِمَثَلٍ فَمِي. أُذِيعُ أَلْغَازًا مُنْذُ ٱلْقِدَمِ.
verses.en: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;
verses.kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבֹותֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָֽנוּ׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي سَمِعْنَاهَا وَعَرَفْنَاهَا وَآبَاؤُنَا أَخْبَرُونَا.
verses.en: That which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us,
verses.kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.web: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.he: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד ׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְדֹ֥ור אַחֲרֹ֗ון מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלֹּ֣ות יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּזֹ֥ו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.ar: لَا نُخْفِي عَنْ بَنِيهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْجِيلِ ٱلْآخِرِ، مُخْبِرِينَ بِتَسَابِيحِ ٱلرَّبِّ وَقُوَّتِهِ وَعَجَائِبِهِ ٱلَّتِي صَنَعَ.
verses.en: We will not hide from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done.
verses.kjv: We will not hide [them] from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

verses.he: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת ׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתֹורָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־אֲבֹותֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הֹודִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: أَقَامَ شَهَادَةً فِي يَعْقُوبَ، وَوَضَعَ شَرِيعَةً فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَى آبَاءَنَا أَنْ يُعَرِّفُوا بِهَا أَبْنَاءَهُمْ،
verses.en: For He established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
verses.kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.web: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

verses.he: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ ׀ דֹּ֣ור אַ֭חֲרֹון בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَعْلَمَ ٱلْجِيلُ ٱلْآخِرُ. بَنُونَ يُولَدُونَ فَيَقُومُونَ وَيُخْبِرُونَ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ،
verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; who should arise and tell them to their children,
verses.kjv: That the generation to come might know [them, even] the children [which] should be born; [who] should arise and declare [them] to their children:
verses.web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

verses.he: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: فَيَجْعَلُونَ عَلَى ٱللهِ ٱعْتِمَادَهُمْ، وَلَا يَنْسَوْنَ أَعْمَالَ ٱللهِ، بَلْ يَحْفَظُونَ وَصَايَاهُ.
verses.en: That they might put their confidence in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep His commandments;
verses.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ ׀ כַּאֲבֹותָ֗ם דֹּור֮ סֹורֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דֹּ֭ור לֹא־הֵכִ֣ין לִבֹּ֑ו וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣ל רוּחֹֽו׃
verses.ar: وَلَا يَكُونُونَ مِثْلَ آبَائِهِمْ، جِيلًا زَائِغًا وَمَارِدًا، جِيلًا لَمْ يُثَبِّتْ قَلْبَهُ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ رُوحُهُ أَمِينَةً لِلهِ.
verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation [that] set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.web: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

verses.he: בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נֹושְׁקֵ֥י רֹומֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּיֹ֣ום קְרָֽב׃
verses.ar: بَنُو أَفْرَايِمَ ٱلنَّازِعُونَ فِي ٱلْقَوْسِ، ٱلرَّامُونَ، ٱنْقَلَبُوا فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْحَرْبِ.
verses.en: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, that turned back in the day of battle.
verses.kjv: The children of Ephraim, [being] armed, [and] carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.he: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתֹורָתֹ֗ו מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃
verses.ar: لَمْ يَحْفَظُوا عَهْدَ ٱللهِ، وَأَبَوْا ٱلسُّلُوكَ فِي شَرِيعَتِهِ،
verses.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in His law;
verses.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילֹותָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאֹותָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَنَسُوا أَفْعَالَهُ وَعَجَائِبَهُ ٱلَّتِي أَرَاهُمْ.
verses.en: And they forgot His doings, and His wondrous works that He had shown them.
verses.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

verses.he: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בֹותָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃
verses.ar: قُدَّامَ آبَائِهِمْ صَنَعَ أُعْجُوبَةً فِي أَرْضِ مِصْرَ، بِلَادِ صُوعَنَ.
verses.en: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.
verses.web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.he: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־מַ֥יִם כְּמֹו־נֵֽד׃
verses.ar: شَقَّ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَعَبَّرَهُمْ، وَنَصَبَ ٱلْمِيَاهَ كَنَدٍّ.
verses.en: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; and He made the waters to stand as a heap.
verses.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יֹומָ֑ם וְכָל־הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּאֹ֣ור אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.ar: وَهَدَاهُمْ بِٱلسَّحَابِ نَهَارًا، وَٱللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ بِنُورِ نَارٍ.
verses.en: By day also He led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

verses.he: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמֹ֥ות רַבָּֽה׃
verses.ar: شَقَّ صُخُورًا فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَسَقَاهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ مِنْ لُجَجٍ عَظِيمَةٍ.
verses.en: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.
verses.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as [out of] the great depths.
verses.web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

verses.he: וַיֹּוצִ֣א נֹוזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיֹּ֖ורֶד כַּנְּהָרֹ֣ות מָֽיִם׃
verses.ar: أَخْرَجَ مَجَارِيَ مِنْ صَخْرَةٍ، وَأَجْرَى مِيَاهًا كَٱلْأَنْهَارِ.
verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.he: וַיֹּוסִ֣יפוּ עֹ֖וד לַחֲטֹא־לֹ֑ו לַֽמְרֹ֥ות עֶ֝לְיֹ֗ון בַּצִּיָּֽה׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَادُوا أَيْضًا لِيُخْطِئُوا إِلَيْهِ، لِعِصْيَانِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلنَّاشِفَةِ.
verses.en: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל־אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.ar: وَجَرَّبُوا ٱللهَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ، بِسُؤَالِهِمْ طَعَامًا لِشَهْوَتِهِمْ.
verses.en: And they tried God in their heart by asking food for their craving.
verses.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

verses.he: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.ar: فَوَقَعُوا فِي ٱللهِ. قَالُوا: «هَلْ يَقْدِرُ ٱللهُ أَنْ يُرَتِّبَ مَائِدَةً فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ؟
verses.en: Yea, they spoke against God; they said: 'Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

verses.he: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־צ֨וּר ׀ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם־לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם־יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: هُوَذَا ضَرَبَ ٱلصَّخْرَةَ فَجَرَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ وَفَاضَتِ ٱلْأَوْدِيَةُ. هَلْ يَقْدِرُ أَيْضًا أَنْ يُعْطِيَ خُبْزًا، أَوْ يُهَيِّئَ لَحْمًا لِشَعْبِهِ؟».
verses.en: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed; can He give bread also? or will He provide flesh for His people?'
verses.kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

verses.he: לָכֵ֤ן ׀ שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ سَمِعَ ٱلرَّبُّ فَغَضِبَ، وَٱشْتَعَلَتْ نَارٌ فِي يَعْقُوبَ، وَسَخَطٌ أَيْضًا صَعِدَ عَلَى إِسْرَائِيلَ،
verses.en: Therefore the LORD heard, and was wroth; and a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also went up against Israel;
verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD heard [this], and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.web: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِٱللهِ وَلَمْ يَتَّكِلُوا عَلَى خَلَاصِهِ.
verses.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in His salvation.
verses.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

verses.he: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃
verses.ar: فَأَمَرَ ٱلسَّحَابَ مِنْ فَوْقُ، وَفَتَحَ مَصَارِيعَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ.
verses.en: And He commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven;
verses.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן־שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמֹו׃
verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَنًّا لِلْأَكْلِ، وَبُرَّ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَعْطَاهُمْ.
verses.en: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, and gave them of the corn of heaven.
verses.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

verses.he: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
verses.ar: أَكَلَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ خُبْزَ ٱلْمَلَائِكَةِ. أَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ زَادًا لِلشِّبَعِ.
verses.en: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.
verses.kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

verses.he: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזֹּ֣ו תֵימָֽן׃
verses.ar: أَهَاجَ شَرْقِيَّةً فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ، وَسَاقَ بِقُوَّتِهِ جَنُوبِيَّةً.
verses.en: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; and by His power He brought on the south wind.
verses.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

verses.he: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְחֹ֥ול יַ֝מִּ֗ים עֹ֣וף כָּנָֽף׃
verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَحْمًا مِثْلَ ٱلتُّرَابِ، وَكَرَمْلِ ٱلْبَحْرِ طُيُورًا ذَوَاتِ أَجْنِحَةٍ.
verses.en: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, and winged fowl as the sand of the seas;
verses.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.web: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

verses.he: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْقَطَهَا فِي وَسَطِ مَحَلَّتِهِمْ حَوَالَيْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ.
verses.en: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their dwellings.
verses.kjv: And he let [it] fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.web: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

verses.he: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: فَأَكَلُوا وَشَبِعُوا جِدًّا، وَأَتَاهُمْ بِشَهْوَتِهِمْ.
verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled; and He gave them that which they craved.
verses.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

verses.he: לֹא־זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם עֹ֝֗וד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: لَمْ يَزُوغُوا عَنْ شَهْوَتِهِمْ. طَعَامُهُمْ بَعْدُ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ،
verses.en: They were not estranged from their craving, their food was yet in their mouths,
verses.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat [was] yet in their mouths,
verses.web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

verses.he: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃
verses.ar: فَصَعِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبُ ٱللهِ، وَقَتَلَ مِنْ أَسْمَنِهِمْ، وَصَرَعَ مُخْتَارِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: When the anger of God went up against them, and slew of the lustieth among them, and smote down the young men of Israel.
verses.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen [men] of Israel.
verses.web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

verses.he: בְּכָל־זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ־עֹ֑וד וְלֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאֹותָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فِي هَذَا كُلِّهِ أَخْطَأُوا بَعْدُ، وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِعَجَائِبِهِ.
verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not in His wondrous works.
verses.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

verses.he: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנֹותָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَأَفْنَى أَيَّامَهُمْ بِٱلْبَاطِلِ وَسِنِيهِمْ بِٱلرُّعْبِ.
verses.en: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, and their years in terror.
verses.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

verses.he: אִם־הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־אֵֽל׃
verses.ar: إِذْ قَتَلَهُمْ طَلَبُوهُ، وَرَجَعُوا وَبَكَّرُوا إِلَى ٱللهِ،
verses.en: When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, and turn back and seek God earnestly.
verses.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיֹון גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَذَكَرُوا أَنَّ ٱللهَ صَخْرَتُهُمْ، وَٱللهَ ٱلْعَلِيَّ وَلِيُّهُمْ.
verses.en: And they remembered that God was their Rock, and the Most High God their redeemer.
verses.kjv: And they remembered that God [was] their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

verses.he: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשֹׁונָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ־לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَخَادَعُوهُ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ، وَكَذَبُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ.
verses.en: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, and lied unto Him with their tongue.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

verses.he: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־נָכֹ֣ון עִמֹּ֑ו וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا قُلُوبُهُمْ فَلَمْ تُثَبَّتْ مَعَهُ، وَلَمْ يَكُونُوا أُمَنَاءَ فِي عَهْدِهِ.
verses.en: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, neither were they faithful in His covenant.
verses.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

verses.he: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֹן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפֹּ֑ו וְלֹֽא־יָ֝עִיר כָּל־חֲמָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا هُوَ فَرَؤُوفٌ، يَغْفِرُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَلَا يُهْلِكُ. وَكَثِيرًا مَا رَدَّ غَضَبَهُ، وَلَمْ يُشْعِلْ كُلَّ سَخَطِهِ.
verses.en: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, and doth not stir up all His wrath.
verses.kjv: But he, [being] full of compassion, forgave [their] iniquity, and destroyed [them] not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ הֹ֝ולֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.ar: ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُمْ بَشَرٌ. رِيحٌ تَذْهَبُ وَلَا تَعُودُ.
verses.en: So He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.kjv: For he remembered that they [were but] flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

verses.he: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֹֽון׃
verses.ar: كَمْ عَصَوْهُ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ وَأَحْزَنُوهُ فِي ٱلْقَفْرِ!
verses.en: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, and grieve Him in the desert!
verses.kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, [and] grieve him in the desert!
verses.web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

verses.he: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְדֹ֖ושׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ׃
verses.ar: رَجَعُوا وَجَرَّبُوا ٱللهَ وَعَنَّوْا قُدُّوسَ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And still again they tried God, and set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

verses.he: לֹא־זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־יָדֹ֑ו יֹ֝֗ום אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־צָֽר׃
verses.ar: لَمْ يَذْكُرُوا يَدَهُ يَوْمَ فَدَاهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْعَدُوِّ،
verses.en: They remembered not His hand, nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.
verses.kjv: They remembered not his hand, [nor] the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתֹותָ֑יו וּ֝מֹופְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃
verses.ar: حَيْثُ جَعَلَ فِي مِصْرَ آيَاتِهِ، وَعَجَائِبَهُ فِي بِلَادِ صُوعَنَ.
verses.en: How He set His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the field of Zoan;
verses.kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

verses.he: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
verses.ar: إِذْ حَوَّلَ خُلْجَانَهُمْ إِلَى دَمٍ، وَمَجَارِيَهُمْ لِكَيْ لَا يَشْرَبُوا.
verses.en: And turned their rivers into blood, so that they could not drink their streams.
verses.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ بَعُوضًا فَأَكَلَهُمْ، وَضَفَادِعَ فَأَفْسَدَتْهُمْ.
verses.en: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.ar: أَسْلَمَ لِلْجَرْدَمِ غَلَّتَهُمْ، وَتَعَبَهُمْ لِلْجَرَادِ.
verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.web: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

verses.he: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמֹותָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃
verses.ar: أَهْلَكَ بِٱلْبَرَدِ كُرُومَهُمْ، وَجُمَّيْزَهُمْ بِٱلصَّقِيعِ.
verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore-trees with frost.
verses.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَدَفَعَ إِلَى ٱلْبَرَدِ بَهَائِمَهُمْ، وَمَوَاشِيَهُمْ لِلْبُرُوقِ.
verses.en: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to fiery bolts.
verses.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.web: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.he: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּ֨ם ׀ חֲרֹ֬ון אַפֹּ֗ו עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حُمُوَّ غَضَبِهِ، سَخَطًا وَرِجْزًا وَضِيْقًا، جَيْشَ مَلَائِكَةٍ أَشْرَارٍ.
verses.en: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, a sending of messengers of evil.
verses.kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels [among them].
verses.web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

verses.he: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פֹּ֥ו לֹא־חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃
verses.ar: مَهَّدَ سَبِيلًا لِغَضَبِهِ. لَمْ يَمْنَعْ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَنْفُسَهُمْ، بَلْ دَفَعَ حَيَاتَهُمْ لِلْوَبَإِ.
verses.en: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכֹ֣ור בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝ונִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ كُلَّ بِكْرٍ فِي مِصْرَ. أَوَائِلَ ٱلْقُدْرَةِ فِي خِيَامِ حَامٍ.
verses.en: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, the first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;
verses.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of [their] strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

verses.he: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמֹּ֑ו וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.ar: وَسَاقَ مِثْلَ ٱلْغَنَمِ شَعْبَهُ، وَقَادَهُمْ مِثْلَ قَطِيعٍ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ.
verses.en: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.he: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־אֹ֝ויְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃
verses.ar: وَهَدَاهُمْ آمِنِينَ فَلَمْ يَجْزَعُوا. أَمَّا أَعْدَاؤُهُمْ فَغَمَرَهُمُ ٱلْبَحْرُ.
verses.en: And He led them safely, and they feared not; but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.he: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּב֣וּל קָדְשֹׁ֑ו הַר־זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֹֽו׃
verses.ar: وَأَدْخَلَهُمْ فِي تُخُومِ قُدْسِهِ، هَذَا ٱلْجَبَلِ ٱلَّذِي ٱقْتَنَتْهُ يَمِينُهُ.
verses.en: And He brought them to His holy border, to the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.
verses.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, [even to] this mountain, [which] his right hand had purchased.
verses.web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

verses.he: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם ׀ גֹּויִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: وَطَرَدَ ٱلْأُمَمَ مِنْ قُدَّامِهِمْ وَقَسَمَهُمْ بِٱلْحَبْلِ مِيرَاثًا، وَأَسْكَنَ فِي خِيَامِهِمْ أَسْبَاطَ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: He drove out the nations also before them, and allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.he: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְיֹ֑ון וְ֝עֵדֹותָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.ar: فَجَرَّبُوا وَعَصَوْا ٱللهَ ٱلْعَلِيَّ، وَشَهَادَاتِهِ لَمْ يَحْفَظُوا،
verses.en: Yet they tried and provoked God, the Most High, and kept not His testimonies;
verses.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

verses.he: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבֹותָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.ar: بَلِ ٱرْتَدُّوا وَغَدَرُوا مِثْلَ آبَائِهِمْ. ٱنْحَرَفُوا كَقَوْسٍ مُخْطِئَةٍ.
verses.en: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

verses.he: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמֹותָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃
verses.ar: أَغَاظُوهُ بِمُرْتَفَعَاتِهِمْ، وَأَغَارُوهُ بِتَمَاثِيلِهِمْ.
verses.en: For they provoked Him with their high places, and moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

verses.he: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: سَمِعَ ٱللهُ فَغَضِبَ، وَرَذَلَ إِسْرَائِيلَ جِدًّا،
verses.en: God heard, and was wroth, and He greatly abhorred Israel;
verses.kjv: When God heard [this], he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

verses.ar: وَرَفَضَ مَسْكِنَ شِيلُوِ، ٱلْخَيْمَةَ ٱلَّتِي نَصَبَهَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.en: And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which He had made to dwell among men;
verses.kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent [which] he placed among men;
verses.web: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזֹּ֑ו וְֽתִפְאַרְתֹּ֥ו בְיַד־צָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَسَلَّمَ لِلسَّبْيِ عِزَّهُ، وَجَلَالَهُ لِيَدِ ٱلْعَدُوِّ.
verses.en: And delivered His strength into captivity, and His glory into the adversary's hand.
verses.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
verses.web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

verses.he: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמֹּ֑ו וּ֝בְנַחֲלָתֹ֗ו הִתְעַבָּֽר׃
verses.ar: وَدَفَعَ إِلَى ٱلسَّيْفِ شَعْبَهُ، وَغَضِبَ عَلَى مِيرَاثِهِ.
verses.en: He gave His people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with His inheritance.
verses.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

verses.he: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָֽכְלָה־אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.ar: مُخْتَارُوهُ أَكَلَتْهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ، وَعَذَارَاهُ لَمْ يُحْمَدْنَ.
verses.en: Fire devoured their young men; and their virgins had no marriage-song.
verses.kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

verses.he: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.ar: كَهَنَتُهُ سَقَطُوا بِٱلسَّيْفِ، وَأَرَامِلُهُ لَمْ يَبْكِينَ.
verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

verses.he: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבֹּ֗ור מִתְרֹונֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.ar: فَٱسْتَيْقَظَ ٱلرَّبُّ كَنَائِمٍ، كَجَبَّارٍ مُعَيِّطٍ مِنَ ٱلْخَمْرِ.
verses.en: Then the Lord awaked as one asleep, like a mighty man recovering from wine.
verses.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, [and] like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

verses.he: וַיַּךְ־צָרָ֥יו אָחֹ֑ור חֶרְפַּ֥ת עֹ֝ולָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמֹו׃
verses.ar: فَضَرَبَ أَعْدَاءَهُ إِلَى ٱلْوَرَاءِ. جَعَلَهُمْ عَارًا أَبَدِيًّا.
verses.en: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.
verses.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יֹוסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃
verses.ar: وَرَفَضَ خَيْمَةَ يُوسُفَ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَرْ سِبْطَ أَفْرَايِمَ.
verses.en: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

verses.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֥ר צִ֝יֹּ֗ון אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.ar: بَلِ ٱخْتَارَ سِبْطَ يَهُوذَا، جَبَلَ صِهْيَوْنَ ٱلَّذِي أَحَبَّهُ.
verses.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which He loved.
verses.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

verses.he: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמֹו־רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשֹׁ֑ו כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَبَنَى مِثْلَ مُرْتَفَعَاتٍ مَقْدِسَهُ، كَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَسَّسَهَا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which He hath founded for ever.
verses.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high [palaces], like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדֹּ֑ו וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.ar: وَٱخْتَارَ دَاوُدَ عَبْدَهُ، وَأَخَذَهُ مِنْ حَظَائِرِ ٱلْغَنَمِ.
verses.en: He chose David also His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

verses.he: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָלֹ֗ות הֱ֫בִיאֹ֥ו לִ֭רְעֹות בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמֹּ֑ו וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: مِنْ خَلْفِ ٱلْمُرْضِعَاتِ أَتَى بِهِ، لِيَرْعَى يَعْقُوبَ شَعْبَهُ، وَإِسْرَائِيلَ مِيرَاثَهُ.
verses.en: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, to be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.
verses.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

verses.he: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָבֹ֑ו וּבִתְבוּנֹ֖ות כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃
verses.ar: فَرَعَاهُمْ حَسَبَ كَمَالِ قَلْبِهِ، وَبِمَهَارَةِ يَدَيْهِ هَدَاهُمْ.
verses.en: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; and lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
